subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 25, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 25, 2026

Good morning, AcreetionOS community! Our development team has been hard at work refining the build pipeline and squashing bugs across multiple repositories. The latest commits show significant progress on CI/CD infrastructure, with Darren fixing the release workflow indentation that was blocking validation and optimizing the GitHub release creation step. These improvements mean faster, more reliable ISO deliveries for everyone.

On the XLibre front, we've added firefox-ublock-origin to the build configuration, ensuring our privacy-focused browser stack ships with robust content blocking out of the box. The GitLab mirror deployment key issue has been resolved and the mirror re-triggered, restoring smooth synchronization between our GitHub and self-hosted GitLab instances. Code quality got a boost too, with explicit shellcheck linting now enforced on all top-level scripts in the main repository.

Community-wise, the F-Droid project just announced version 2.0, marking a major milestone for Android software freedom that aligns perfectly with our values. Researchers at Graz University of Technology have published concerning findings about file-notification attacks on Linux, a reminder of why our privacy-first, minimal-attack-surface approach matters. After a two-year hiatus, Jonathan Corbet's Kernel Report 2026 edition dropped at Kernel Recipes, offering essential insights into where the Linux kernel is heading.

For tips and highlights, don't forget that AcreetionMediaWriter makes flashing our ISOs painless from Windows, macOS, or Linux — no dd command memorization required. Our Fluorite and Cryolite browsers continue to receive upstream security updates, giving you Chromium and Firefox-based options that prioritize your privacy by default. The LGBTQ Tracker and Trans Tracker projects on Natalie's site remain vital resources for monitoring legislation affecting our community.

Finally, our Discord server at discord.gg/VHqQkJASw7 is the best place for real-time support, development discussions, and hanging out with fellow AcreetionOS users. The wiki at acreetionos.org/wiki has expanded installation guides and troubleshooting pages based on recent community questions. Thank you for being part of this two-person miracle — we're building something special together, one commit at a time.
